# Diagnostics reference

Every diagnostic code (the `ErrorCode` union in src/model/types.ts) with what it means, where the tool raises it and a representative message. A diagnostic has: `code`, a user-facing `message`, an optional `fieldPath` (e.g. graphs[0].nodes[2].params.rate), an optional `nodeId` and a `severity` (error blocks the change or compile; warning is advisory). MCP tools print them as `- [CODE] nodeId (fieldPath): message`. Messages containing `…` had a computed value in that spot. Compile/preview also produces plain-text warnings (tail cut off, event ticks, glow flooding, unused nodes) that are not coded; they are self-explanatory and are described in the troubleshooting chapter.

Note: the editor's undo/redo patch errors (src/editor/history.ts) reuse a few of these words as a separate internal error class and are not listed here.
